science.qualification: Uniform photosphere colour from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum, dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017) computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band, at the star's temperature and gravity from Bruntt et al. (2010): a model, because no transit fit of this star's limb is used. The disc is unresolved: no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting.
